description: Permanently delete one of the workspace's stored logos, e.g. an outdated logo or to free one of the seven slots before upload_logo. It cannot be undone through this server; the logo has to be uploaded again to restore it. Photos already generated keep the logo they were made with, and later generate_background calls can no longer use this `id`. Get the `id` from list_logos, and pass the same `type` the logo was listed under (`logo` by default, or `plate`). Free. Returns the `id` with `deleted: true`, or `not_found` when the id is unknown for that type.

type.description: `logo` (default): logos drawn on finished photos. `plate`: designs put on the license plate.

name: delete_logo
title: Delete logo
